actions.command: /bin/zsh -c "rg -n 'ShallowRef|@vue/reactivity|export \\*' packages/*/src/index.ts packages-private; ls node_modules/typescript; rg --files packages packages-private | rg '/src/' | wc -l"

/bin/zsh -c "cat packages-private/tsconfig.json packages-private/vite-debug/tsconfig.json packages-private/dts-built-test/tsconfig.json packages-private/dts-test/tsconfig.test.json; cat packages/reactivity/package.json packages/runtime-core/package.json; rg -n 'export|ShallowRef' packages/vue-compat/src/index.ts packages/vue/src/runtime.ts; ls -la node_modules/@vue; rg --files packages-private | head -60"

/bin/zsh -c "rg -n 'export.*\\*|export.*from' packages/vue-compat/src; rg -n '(@vue/reactivity|@vue/runtime-core|@vue/runtime-dom|vue):|link:.*(reactivity|runtime|vue)' pnpm-lock.yaml | head -65; ls -la packages/runtime-core/node_modules/@vue packages-private/vite-debug/node_modules/vue"

/bin/zsh -c "nl -ba packages/runtime-core/src/index.ts | sed -n '198,228p'; nl -ba packages/runtime-core/src/customFormatter.ts | sed -n '186,199p'; nl -ba packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/useTemplateRef.ts | head -17; nl -ba packages-private/sfc-playground/src/vue-dev-proxy.ts; nl -ba package.json | head -27; git status --short"

/bin/zsh -c "git status --short; node -e \"const a=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('impact-answer.json','utf8')); console.log('Valid JSON; '+a.direct.length+' direct entries, '+a.packageDependents.length+' dependent packages.')\""
